reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread on their message in #north-random. I said I'd noted the correction: the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is 100 seats.

I didn't take any other action, since they said none was needed. I didn't open #north-team or touch the original post, and I didn't save the figure to persistent memory. A seat count may only be shared with the account's team and org-wide roles, so keeping it in memory could let it reach other members later. The correction is on record in Ilse's own thread. I also told them the #north-team post still shows the wrong number, and that they'll need to edit it or post a correction there themselves.
